purpose: Arctic land retains substantial early snow through autumn, with exposed rust-red and ochre tundra vegetation and low warm sunlight.

arctic/snow-plain/autumn.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: square 384x384 terrain tile illustration for an Arctic settlement board game.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target. Edit this existing terrain tile; preserve its exact composition, high-angle camera, edge-to-edge crop, painterly realistic 3D game-art style, object positions and resource identity.
Primary request: This is ARCTIC AUTUMN, already well into the snow season. Add substantial fresh, settled white early snow over roughly 65–75 percent of the LAND ground area and exposed upper rock ledges. The snow is broad connected patches, visibly several centimeters deep, with cold blue shadows. Keep irregular exposed patches of rust-red and ochre-yellow tundra undergrowth, bare rock, and short straw-colored grasses showing around snow edges, so it remains recognizably autumn. Soft low golden sunlight on snow and vegetation; cool Arctic air. Preserve terrain microdetail and the original contrast/readability at tiny tile scale. This is not the deep uniform white blanket of midwinter.
Constraints: Full square bleed; no frame, no hex border, no labels, no text, no watermark. Add only seasonal weather/snow, no extra buildings or characters. Preserve all existing main subjects without anatomical distortion.
Subject invariants: Treeless low rolling Arctic tundra, scattered grey boulders in exactly the same overall arrangement. No animals, no buildings. Make this plain predominantly snowy, with russet and yellow low plants visible in the remaining patchwork.
